Head Clerk Meadhoney is the head clerk of the Counting House in the Lower City. He can be spoken with to gain access to the vaults (peacefully).

Involvement

Upon speaking to Meadhoney at the front desk of the Counting House, a passive  DC 10 Insight Check occurs in the background. If successful, it is revealed that Meadhoney is rattled by something. When this is pointed out, Meadhoney uneasily explains, that a "large and heavily armed fellow" just led  Head Banker Glitterbeard down to the lower vaults and Meadhoney is worried for him.

The party can then make a check to offer to go down there and see if everything is alright:

  • [PERSUASION] Let me help. I'll go and check on your Head Banker (DC 18)
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] I'm something of a security expert. That sounds like a breach - why don't I go check? (DC 15)
  • [SORCERER] [PERSUASION] I wield magic with the ease of breathing - perhaps I could help? Maybe check on your Head Banker? (DC 15)
  • [HALF-ORC] [PERSUASION] I'm rather large and heavily armed myself. Why not let me check on your Head Banker, just to be safe? (DC 15)
  • [MONK] [PERSUASION] I can check on your banker. Your vaults are safe from me - I have no interest in gold. (DC 15)
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] [PERSUASION] I am oathbound to serve the city's officials. Let me help. (DC 15)
  • [HALF-ORC] [INTIMIDATION] I'm rather heavily armed myself. I'll be heading down below, too. (DC 18)
  • [FIGHTER] [INTIMIDATION] I'm armed and far more dangerous - so I'll see myself downstairs. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] And everything will stay fine. So long as you let me down into your vault. (DC 15)
  • [EVIL CLERIC] [INTIMIDATION] Nothing is fine. This place is about to suffer a terrible curse - unless you let me down into the vault. (DC 15)

On a successful roll, Meadhoney takes them up on their offer and gives them a  temporary vault pass.

If the interacting party member fails the passive Insight check then they can ask Meadhoney for permission to enter the vaults. He must be persuaded or convinced otherwise (e.g., by spending 10,000 gold to buy an account and their own vault pass). One method is only available if  Jaheira is in the party; she can talk to Meadhoney about the individual who went down to the vaults. This allows several easier checks to gain a temporary vault pass when Meadhoney asks who he is to the party:

  • [INTIMIDATION] The absolute least of your problems if you don't shut up and let us pass. (DC 10)
  • [PERSUASION] A friend. He might do something stupid down there, but we can help. (DC 10)
  • [DECEPTION] A lord of Rashemen - and we are his servants. He's likely to pull his contract if we don't set up his banquet table soon. (DC 10)

Regardless of the method used to obtain the bank pass, party members with the  Criminal background gain the inspiration ⁠Key to the Vault.
